name: Koryo
summary: Players build influence by playing characters from nine families over eight seasons to win majority bonuses.
rules_text: Shuffle 45 character cards (9 families, numbered 1 to 9 copies) with 10 events (6 Barbarian, 4 Lobbying) into a draw pile. Stack 8 Season cards 1-8 face down; each shows cards to deal this round and max cards allowed in tableau. 8 VP tokens aside. Over 8 rounds, four phases in clockwise order from first player: 1) Distribution: reveal Season, deal that many cards to each; player with majority of Broadcasters (#8) gets +1. 2) Order: in turn each player places face-down 0+ cards, all must be identical type (same family or same event), unless he has majority of Ship Owners (#5) then may play 2 different types. Unplayed cards are reshuffled into draw. 3) Action: reveal played cards to tableau. On your turn you may use powers if you have majority of that family: Banker (#6) take a VP token if any remains, Priest (#4) discard one of your Events, Spy (#2) steal a VP token from opponent (needs majority), Omniscient (#1) tie-breaker for majority powers during game (not final scoring). Events resolve immediately: Barbarian destroys one opponent character except a player with Guardian majority (#7) is immune; Lobbying swaps 2 characters between two players except a player with Spy majority and no Guardian is immune. 4) Ending: if tableau exceeds Season max, discard Characters (not Events) down to limit; Senator majority (#3) gives +2 limit. Pass first player. After round 8, for each family the player with most cards scores its value (9 to 1). Each Event in tableau is -1, each VP token is +1. Highest total wins.
rating_reason: Card majority game with hidden hands, sequential choice, clear ranking.
